key_claims: Colombia scratched its way into top three cycling destinations after only 6-7 days of riding
Terrain variety is critical for cycling destinations - need uphills, downhills, coastal routes, flat routes, and gravel sections
Iconic climbs are important considerations - examples include Lettras (Colombia), Mont Ventoux (France), Rocacoba (Andorra), Siler (Mallorca), Mount Teide (Tenerife)
Motorist respect matters more than traffic density alone - Lettras is heavily trafficked but motorists are respectful, contrasting with high-traffic disrespectful US drivers
Infrastructure and cultural experience beyond cycling is essential - Tenerife has great riding but lacks amenities for partners and rest day activities, unlike Girona
specific_numbers: 89% of statistics are untrue and 92% of people notice
Only 6-7 days total in Colombia at time of recording
cluster_reasoning: This is a cultural/travel exploration episode about cycling destinations and the lifestyle experience around riding, not training methodology, nutrition, strength work, or recovery science—purely community interest.
